title: cross-stave harm-veto transfer validation
winner_selection: primary transfer split; coverage>=0.50 then min accepted_charge_res68_frac, accepted_timing_abs68_ns, calibration_ece

leakage_audit.primary_split: B2 rows from non-held-out runs train B4/B6/B8 held-out rows

finding: The primary B2-to-B4/B6/B8 transfer winner is mlp: accepted charge res68 0.0555 at coverage 0.571, precision 0.855, recall 0.929, and timing abs68 0.199 ns. The traditional rule gives charge res68 0.0819 at coverage 0.770. The raw reproduction gate matched 640737 selected B-stave pulses exactly.
